notes.title: Stars and Screws update
notes.content: [p]The first update of Practical Pinball is out! What's changed? [/p][p][b]Tables[/b][/p][list][*][p]I added two new tables with unique themes![/p][/*][*][p]I attempted to squash some bugs for better gaming experience[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboards! One part still needs fixing so stay tuned for that in the next update![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]The computer for saving stats has arrived! More equipment, as well as the saving system, are still on their way.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters now pop up at each table to show who the table is themed after.[/p][/*][*][p]Other small changes![/p][/*][/list][p]I hope you'll enjoy this update! I'll keep updating it as long as people are interested![/p][p][/p]
